messages:
ana_docs: FYI I opened a small PR to clarify tiered usage examples + add a short SDK migration snippet for customers moving from `getUsageTiers()` -> `fetchUsageTiers()` — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 :pray:
kevin_devex: thanks! can you paste the snippet here? want to sanity-check the method signature and the example response shape before review.
sam_eng: quick note — we renamed the metric prefix in telemetry last week from `redwood.rate.limit` -> `redwood.rate_limit` so docs should recommend the new name (and call out the old one as legacy). small heads-up for dashboards.
nana_docs: @sam_eng good catch, will add a short note. Ana: snippet (inline):
```js
// before
const tiers = await sdk.getUsageTiers(projectId);

// after
const tiers = await sdk.fetchUsageTiers({ projectId });
console.log(tiers); // [{name: 'free', tokens: 50_000, burst: true}]
```
nana_docs: Also added an example of how to map tier names to dashboard panels (panel regex + metric rename) and a short migration checklist for customers with custom Grafana queries.
kevin_devex: tiny nit: can we show the response object keys explicitly in the snippet (e.g., `id`, `name`, `allocation_tokens`, `burst_window`) so SDK users don't rely on positional arrays?
nana_docs: done, updated PR to include explicit example response and a one-liner about stable keys. also added an admonition: "If you rely on the old metric name, update queries to use `redwood.rate_limit` and set up a 30-day alias."
ci-bot: build passed for docs PR #4212 — 3 files changed, 2 tests successful.
kevin_devex: LGTM apart from one wording nit on the dashboard paragraph (sounds authoritative; maybe soften to "recommended" rather than "required").
sam_eng: confirm we should avoid recommending changing historical dashboards immediately — customers might prefer the alias approach. added a comment on the PR.
nana_docs: reworded to "recommended" and added an alias snippet for Grafana: ```promql
avg_over_time(redwood_rate_limit{tier=~"free|starter"}[30d])
```
nana_docs: also added a tiny migration note for SDK users: call `sdk.fetchUsageTiers({compat: true})` to get old keys back for a 2-week migration window (internal flag only, documented here).
kevin_devex: perfect. I'll approve if CI stays green and we add a changelog line under "Docs" in the PR template.
nana_docs: added changelog line. thanks all :thumbsup:
